literal_meaning: জল দিয়ে তৈরি আলপনা বা তিলক বা দাগ (water-based decorative design or forehead mark or stain)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার প্রতিশ্রুতি তো জলের আলপনার মতো, কিছুদিন পরেই মুছে যাবে।
এই সম্পর্ক জলের তিলকের মতো ক্ষণস্থায়ী।
example_sentences_in_english: His promise is like a water-based alpona, it will fade away in a few days.
This relationship is as temporary as a water tilak.
history: আলপনা is a traditional Bengali folk art form using rice paste for temporary floor decorations during festivals like Durga Puja, symbolizing impermanence in rural and semi-urban settings.
note: The idiom draws from traditional practices where water or temporary mediums create designs that wash away easily, emphasizing transience.
